This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] [[Pokémon Picross (Game Boy Color)|Pokémon Picross]] for the [[Game Boy Color]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was developed by [[Jupiter Corporation]], but was never officially released. All names are given in Western order.
